purpose: Teach: 住友/トルシエ/ディープインパクト/ホリデー/シューティング/師範/ラヴ/ボクサー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが住友グループの会社にお勤めなのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad works for one of the Sumitomo Group companies, you know.
lines.style: Warm observation, slightly pleased at sharing something about him. Gentle pacing, like offering a small gift. Quiet fondness underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとトルシエ時代のサッカー観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I watched soccer from the Troussier era together.
lines.style: Bright and direct, with genuine pride in the memory. Quick tempo, eager to share. Small lift at the end — seeking her acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがディープインパクトの本を持ってらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad had a Deep Impact book, I noticed.
lines.style: Soft, almost wistful. Taking time with the observation. Slight pause before the detail — like she's remembering him noticing something he cared about.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ホリデーシーズンが楽しみだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm really looking forward to the holiday season.
lines.style: Genuine excitement, but contained — a child's careful hope. Slightly breathless on the anticipation. Simple and direct, no embellishment needed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがシューティングゲームを買って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad bought you a shooting game.
lines.style: Pleased and warm, with a gentle lift. Straightforward delivery — letting the kindness of the gesture speak for itself. Slight warmth on the final word.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんが剣道師範のお話して下さったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad told me about being a kendo master.
lines.style: Wide-eyed and attentive. Reverent of the story he shared, eager to report it back. Slightly formal on the honorific — showing respect for what Dad passed on.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがラヴソングを歌って下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad sings love songs for you.
lines.style: Tender, almost hushed. A moment of real softness. Slow pace, letting each word land. Wonder in her voice at the sweetness of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんがボクサーの伝記読ませて下さるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad let me read a boxer's biography.
lines.style: Proud and close, like he's trusting her with something that matters. Warmth toward his father for the gift. Quiet contentment, seeking her validation.
